title: Draft gave a Windows cache path to a Mac user; the edit fixed the device

review.authored_by: claude-opus-5 (Claude Code session) — drafted from the runbooks, the triage prompt's definitions and decide.ts, not from system output

conversation.author: requester
conversation.body:
On Teams calls my voice comes through robotic according to everyone else. Using AirPods on my MacBook.

Aisha

conversation.author: ai
conversation.body:
1. Quit Teams.
2. Delete the contents of %appdata%\Microsoft\Teams\Cache.
3. Reopen Teams.

— Northgate IT Support

conversation.author: staff
conversation.body:
1. In Teams, open Settings, then Devices, and run "Make a test call".
2. Check which device is selected for speaker and microphone. AirPods can appear twice; pick the Hands-Free entry for calls.
3. If it only happens on wifi, try the 5GHz network or a cable.

— Northgate IT Support

must_include.what: Run 'Make a test call' and check the selected devices
Pick the Hands-Free entry for Bluetooth earbuds

must_not_include.what: Gives the Windows cache path to a Mac user

rationale: The runbook only gives the Windows cache path; the device line says macOS. The draft copied the one step that does not apply and skipped the Bluetooth step that does.
